description: Scan a resource pack root for namespace, model, texture, and atlas integrity and return a read-only verdict with findings. Reads only, never writes.

dependencyPaths.description: Dependency pack roots; the first entry has the highest priority.

minecraftVersion.description: Release Minecraft version 1.19.3 through 26.3 (for example "1.19.3", "1.21.4", "26.3"). Omitted means engine defaults.

resourcePackVersion.description: Target resource-pack version as N or N.M (e.g. 84, 97.1); normalized to major.minor. Omitted means engine defaults.

vanillaPath.description: Vanilla assets directory used to resolve minecraft references.

name: validate_pack_asset
